999008199.text:
ヘルトさん、ゼロさんが決めた期限は１週間。
それまでにクリセルダさんたちを、「管理」……

localizations.en: Held and Zero gave us a week. In that time, we're supposed to 'manage' Criselda and the others...

999008199.text: そんなの、到底受け入れられないわ

あのヘルトは気分屋なんでしょ？　性格をくすぐって、
なんとかいい方向に持っていけないかしら？

localizations.en: Held's capricious, right? Maybe we could play to that somehow? Try to steer things in a better direction?

999008199.text: 下手すると、要求がもっと過激になる危険もあるよ

localizations.en: Could backfire. Might just make their demands even more extreme.

999008199.text:
……何度言わせるのさ。あの二人と話し合うなんて
どだい無理なんだ。異常気象、いや天災なんだよ

localizations.en: ...How many times do I have to say it? There's no reasoning with those two. They're not people—they're natural disasters.

999008199.text:
交渉しようなんて言った瞬間、逆らったと
見なされるかもしれない。そうなったらどうなるか

localizations.en: The moment you try to negotiate, they might see it as defiance. And then what?

999008199.text:
あんたがこんな弱気になってるなんて
初めてかも……よっぽど怖いのね、あの二人

localizations.en: I've never seen you this rattled before... Those two really got to you, didn't they?

999008199.text:
でも、いくら強くても、残された時間が短くても
あの人たちの言いなりになるわけにはいきません！

localizations.en: But no matter how strong they are, no matter how little time we have—we can't just do what they say!

999008199.text:
まずは話し合いです。ですが……
いざという場合も覚悟して、備えておきましょう

localizations.en: We'll try talking to them first. But... we need to be ready for the worst. Let's prepare.

999008199.text:
うん、そうだね！　アタシにできることがあったら
なんでも言ってね！　手伝うよ！

localizations.en: Yeah! If there's anything I can do to help, just say the word!

999008199.text:
それなら、とりあえず回復薬でも
準備しておいてもらいたいな

localizations.en: In that case, we should stock up on healing medicine.

999008199.text:
ジェロンさん！
おケガ、大丈夫なんですか？

localizations.en: Geron! Are you sure you're okay after those injuries?

999008199.text: このくらいは平気だ。またすぐに戦える

localizations.en: This is nothing. I'll be ready to fight again soon.

999008199.text:
兄さんじゃなかったら全治数か月だと思いますよ。
でも、兄さんはまだ戦うつもりで……

localizations.en: If it were anyone but him, they'd be laid up for months. But he still wants to keep fighting...

999008199.text:
当たり前だ。あのヘルトとかいう奴、
長男の風上にも置けないからな

localizations.en: Of course I do. That Held bastard is a disgrace to older brothers everywhere.

999008199.text:
何が兄弟想いだ、本当にそうならば
イェルカやヴァレリアに攻撃しないだろう

localizations.en: What kind of caring sibling attacks their own family? If he really cared about them, he wouldn't have gone after Jelka and Valeria.

999008199.text:
はは、そりゃあそうだ。アタシらは
普通の兄弟から大きく外れちまってるんだねえ

localizations.en: Haha, well, that's true. Guess we're pretty far from a normal family, huh?

999008199.text:
でも、それでも……やっぱり兄弟同士で
争うなんて……そんなの嫌だよ。話し合えないかな

localizations.en: But still... siblings fighting each other like that... I hate it. Can't we at least try to talk to them?

999008199.text:
ティムは優しいな……なあイェルカ。
お前たち本当に話し合う余地はないのか？

localizations.en: You've got a kind heart, Tim... Hey, Jelka. Is there really no room for discussion with them?

999008199.text:
アタシたちはあるけどね。
ただ、向こうがそうとは限らないってのが問題さ

localizations.en: We're open to it. Problem is, they might not be.

999008199.text:
でも、ジェロンの言うことも分かるわ。
少しでも可能性があるなら、諦めずに考えましょう

localizations.en: But I understand what Geron's saying. If there's even a chance, we shouldn't give up.

999008199.text: ヴァレリア。粋なことを言うねぇ
